name: Stone Pillar
description: A standing stone column. Blocks movement and line of fire; hard to be slammed into.

name: Boulder
description: A great rock. Blocks movement and line of fire; hard to be slammed into.

name: Stone Wall
description: A straight stone wall. Blocks movement and line of fire; hard to be slammed into.

name: Rubble
description: A low heap of broken stone. Shots pass over it; a Crest hugging it gets +1 protection die. What wrecks become.

name: Barricade
description: A low timber barricade. Shots pass over it; a Crest hugging it gets +1 protection die.

name: Iron Wall
description: A wall of conjured fast-iron (Iron Codex). Blocks movement and line of fire; hard. Lasts until destroyed or the fight ends.
